briefdescription.para: Moves the BD pointer ahead by an arbitrary number of BDs.

detaileddescription.para: Wraps around to the beginning of the ring when needed. A wraparound occurs when the new BD pointer is greater than the high address in the ring.

parameterdescription.para: is the driver instance that owns the ring.
is the starting BD pointer on input and the final BD pointer on output.
is the number of BD spaces to advance.

simplesect.para: Updates BdPtr when NumBd is not zero.

briefdescription.para: Moves the BD pointer backwards by an arbitrary number of BDs.

detaileddescription.para: Wraps around to the end of the ring when needed. A wraparound occurs when the new BD pointer is less than the base address in the ring.

parameterdescription.para: is the driver instance that owns the ring.
is the starting BD pointer on input and the final BD pointer on output.
is the number of BD spaces to move backward.

simplesect.para: Updates BdPtr when NumBd is not zero.
